subject: Mathematics
summary: Concepts of decimal places (tenths, hundredths, thousandths), expanded forms, comparing decimal numbers, converting fractions to decimals, metric unit conversions, and real-life additions and subtractions.

theory_summary.content:
Each position to the right of the decimal point represents a fraction of 10:
- Tenths: $\frac{1}{10} = 0.1$
- Hundredths: $\frac{1}{100} = 0.01$
- Thousandths: $\frac{1}{1000} = 0.001$
Example: $32.475 = 30 + 2 + \frac{4}{10} + \frac{7}{100} + \frac{5}{1000}$.
To compare two decimals: Compare the whole number parts first; if equal, compare tenths, then hundredths, and so on.

- Length: $1\text{ mm} = 0.1\text{ cm}$; $1\text{ cm} = 0.01\text{ m}$; $1\text{ m} = 0.001\text{ km}$.
- Mass: $1\text{ g} = 0.001\text{ kg}$.
- Money: $1\text{ Paise} = ₹0.01$.

questions.question: In the decimal number $16.532$, what is the place value of the digit $3$?
questions.explanation: In $16.532$, $5$ is at tenths ($0.1$), $3$ is at hundredths ($0.01$), and $2$ is at thousandths ($0.001$).

questions.question: How many hundredths are there in $4\text{ tenths}$?
questions.explanation: $4\text{ tenths} = \frac{4}{10} = \frac{40}{100} = 40\text{ hundredths}$.

questions.question: What is the product of $2.5 \times 0.04$?
questions.explanation: $25 \times 4 = 100$. Decimal places: $1 + 2 = 3$. Moving 3 places from right: $0.100 = 0.1$.

questions.question: Evaluate: $7.2 \div 0.09$.
The fraction $\frac{7}{25}$ expressed as a decimal is _______.
Expressing $45\text{ mm}$ in meters gives _______$\text{ m}$.
questions.explanation: $1\text{ m} = 1000\text{ mm}$, so $45\text{ mm} = \frac{45}{1000}\text{ m} = 0.045\text{ m}$.

questions.question: $0.5$ is equal in value to $0.500$. (True/False)
questions.explanation: Adding trailing zeros to the right of the last digit in the fractional part does not alter its value: $\frac{5}{10} = \frac{500}{1000}$.

questions.question: When a decimal number is divided by $100$, the decimal point moves two places to the right. (True/False)
questions.explanation: Dividing by powers of 10 makes the number smaller; the decimal point shifts to the **left**.

questions.question: Reema bought $3.5\text{ kg}$ of potatoes at ₹24.50 per kg and $2.25\text{ kg}$ of tomatoes at ₹40 per kg. How much change did she receive from a ₹200 note?
questions.answer:
1. Cost of potatoes $= 3.5 \times 24.50 = ₹85.75$.
2. Cost of tomatoes $= 2.25 \times 40 = ₹90.00$.
3. Total bill $= 85.75 + 90.00 = ₹175.75$.
4. Change received $= 200.00 - 175.75 = \mathbf{₹24.25}$.
questions.explanation: Multi-step decimal arithmetic in commercial purchasing.

questions.question:
Convert and evaluate the following in standard SI units:
(a) Express ₹8 and 75 paise in Rupees.
(b) Convert $7\text{ km } 45\text{ m}$ into kilometers.
(c) Convert $5\text{ kg } 8\text{ g}$ into kilograms.
questions.answer:
• **(a) Rupees**:
  $$1\text{ rupee} = 100\text{ paise} \implies 75\text{ paise} = ₹0.75$$
  $$₹8 + ₹0.75 = \mathbf{₹8.75}$$
• **(b) Kilometers**:
  $$1\text{ km} = 1000\text{ m} \implies 45\text{ m} = \frac{45}{1000}\text{ km} = 0.045\text{ km}$$
  $$7\text{ km} + 0.045\text{ km} = \mathbf{7.045\text{ km}}$$
• **(c) Kilograms**:
  $$1\text{ kg} = 1000\text{ g} \implies 8\text{ g} = \frac{8}{1000}\text{ kg} = 0.008\text{ kg}$$
  $$5\text{ kg} + 0.008\text{ kg} = \mathbf{5.008\text{ kg}}$$
questions.explanation: Decimal base-10 and base-1000 metric conversions.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs will give a sum less than $7$?
questions.explanation: Evaluate each pair: (a) $4.35 + 2.55 = 6.90 (b) $3.20 + 3.75 = 6.95 (c) $5.1 + 1.4 = 6.5 Since every pair yields a sum less than $7$, (d) is correct.

questions.question: In $16.532$, the digit $3$ is in which place?
questions.explanation: In $16.532$, $5$ is at tenths ($0.1$), $3$ is at hundredths ($0.01$), and $2$ is at thousandths ($0.001$).

questions.question: What is the total of $2\frac{5}{10} + \frac{8}{10} + \frac{45}{100} + 3\frac{1}{10}$?
Find the value of $10 + 0 + \frac{9}{100} + \frac{5}{1000}$.
The expanded form of $28.001$ is:
questions.explanation: Tens $= 20$, Ones $= 8$, Tenths $= 0$, Hundredths $= 0$, Thousandths $= \frac{1}{1000}$.

questions.question: Write the following as decimal: $200 + 10 + 5 + \frac{6}{10}$.
$60 + 6 + \frac{4}{10} + \frac{8}{100}$ in decimal form can be written as:
$15\text{ mm} = \text{_______ }\text{m}$.
questions.explanation: $1\text{ m} = 1000\text{ mm} \implies 15\text{ mm} = \frac{15}{1000}\text{ m} = 0.015\text{ m}$.

questions.question: $2\text{ m}$ is equal to:
questions.explanation: $1\text{ km} = 1000\text{ m} \implies 2\text{ m} = \frac{2}{1000}\text{ km} = 0.002\text{ km}$.

questions.question: $5\text{ kg } 3\text{ g}$ is expressed in kg using decimals as:
The place value of '$7$' in $32.507$ is:
questions.explanation: Digit $7$ is at the 3rd decimal position after the point $\implies 7\text{ thousandths}$ ($\frac{7}{1000} = 0.007$).

questions.question: Which decimal numbers are represented by points $K$ (halfway between 0 and 1) and $L$ (halfway between 1 and 2) on the number line?
questions.explanation: $K$ is halfway between $0$ and $1 \implies 0.5$; $L$ is halfway between $1$ and $2 \implies 1.5$.

questions.question: Which of the following represents the same quantity?
questions.explanation: Annexing zeros to the right of the extreme right digit in the decimal part does not alter the value: $1.4 = 1.40 = 1.400$.

questions.question: Which of the following sums will be greater than $10$?
The largest among $54.32,\; 54.35,\; 54.23,$ and $5.23$ is:
questions.explanation: Comparing whole parts: $54 > 5$. Among whole part 54: tenths are $3, 3, 2$. Between $54.32$ and $54.35$, compare hundredths: $5 > 2 \implies 54.35$ is the largest.
